title: 富兰克林邓普顿David Mann：ETF互联互通，内地生物科技配置何时落地？
speaker: David Mann

segments.en: And when it comes to the biotech ETF, could you walk us through the composition of the company?
segments.zh: 说到生物科技ETF，能否介绍一下它的成分构成？

segments.en: Are you mainly looking at mainland Chinese biotech firms or are they largely DM more established names?
segments.zh: 主要是内地生物科技公司，还是成熟市场更老牌的企业？

segments.en: Yeah, so that's, the funds are designed to be eligible for the ETF connect program.
segments.zh: 是的，这些产品设计上符合ETF互联互通计划的资格。

segments.en: So there's going to be rules in terms of the percentage between the Hong Kong names and the US names. So the breakdown will be with that.
segments.zh: 香港市场与成熟市场标的的占比会有规则约束，构成会据此安排。

segments.en: But certainly part of the allure of the exposure, especially given the demand, we hope to see from the mainland China investors will be heavy on those Chinese companies.
segments.zh: 但这一配置的吸引力之一，尤其考虑到我们期待来自内地投资者的需求，将重点放在中国公司上。

segments.en: And do you have any sort of rough timeline on when that inclusion could happen on ETF connect?
segments.zh: 对于纳入ETF互联互通，你们有大致的时间表吗？

segments.en: The specific timing, I believe it's typically an AUM threshold, which then has like a six month window.
segments.zh: 具体时点通常取决于规模门槛，之后大约有六个月的窗口期。

segments.en: So getting it launched before the end of the month hopefully puts us on track for called roughly the end of Q1 next year.
segments.zh: 如果能在月底前推出，有望在明年一季度末左右进入轨道。
